articles.title: Iran executes three men convicted over January 2026 protests
articles.summary:
Iran executes three men convicted over January 2026 protests

Iran on Sunday executed three men convicted of taking part in armed unrest during protests in January 2026 and carrying out operations for Israel and the United States, state media reported.

On Saturday, citing judiciary's Mizan Online website, AFP reported the execution of an Iranian,  Mohammad Aref Shahbakhsh, an "operative linked to the terrorist group Jaish al-Zolm (al-Adl)".

Jaish al-Adl is an outlawed militant group in Sistan-Baluchistan province, which has long seen clashes between security forces and armed groups, including Sunni militants and members of the ethnic Baloch minority.

Iran accuses arch-enemies the United States and Israel of supporting armed groups there.

Iran tells Russia talks with US without guarantees won't end conflict, report says
articles.summary:
Iran tells Russia talks with US without guarantees won't end conflict, report says

Iran’s ambassador to Moscow Kazem Jalali has said Iran and Russia have discussed strengthening military and security cooperation, with Tehran stressing that talks with the US could not end the conflict without credible guarantees, according to Mehr News Agency.

Jalali said that during a three-hour meeting, Major General Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council, briefed Russian President Vladimir Putin on Tehran’s strategic priorities, including accelerating construction of the Rasht-Astara railway and completing the International North-South Transport Corridor (INSTC).

Jalali said Rezaei conveyed Tehran’s position that negotiations with Washington could not end the conflict without credible guarantees, citing repeated "US violations of commitments" during previous diplomatic engagements, Mehr reported.

He said Rezaei also explained Iran’s response to a letter from US Vice President JD Vance, stressing that dialogue alone could not provide a basis for ending the war.

According to Jalali, Rezaei cited several instances in which Iran had come under attack during diplomatic initiatives, including negotiations in Oman and Geneva, as well as engagements surrounding the Islamabad MoU.

The ambassador said Tehran had made acceptance of its seven strategic conditions by Washington a prerequisite for any new diplomatic initiative. He added that Moscow understood Iran’s position and agreed that commitments had to be implemented.

articles.title: US offers up to $20M reward for information on Iran’s nuclear program: CENTCOM
articles.summary: The US military’s Central Command (CENTCOM) said on Friday that the Rewards for Justice program is offering up to $20 million for information about Iran’s nuclear program, Anadolu reports. “Rewards for Justice is offering a reward of up to $20 million and possible relocation for information about Iran’s nuclear program,” CENTCOM said in a post on US social media platform X. It said the information could cover facilities, equipment and associated personnel, including those in the scientific community, as well as their movements. archive.forecast_cs: V následujících dnech lze očekávat formální kroky k sestavení nové izraelské vlády pod vedením Gadiho Eisenkota a další diplomatické reakce na americké kroky vůči Íránu. Napětí v bezpečnostní oblasti zůstane zvýšené bez okamžitého vyhlídky na komplexní příměří.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, expect formal steps toward forming a new Israeli government under Gadi Eisenkot and further diplomatic reactions to US actions against Iran. Security tension will remain elevated with no immediate prospect of a comprehensive ceasefire.

archive.security_status_cs: Izrael čelí hluboké politické krizi po nerozhodných volbách a rostoucímu napětí ve vztazích s USA, kde klesá vojenská podpora. Írán mezitím kombinuje diplomatickou ofenzivu s rozsáhlou vojenskou přípravou a varováními před eskalací konfliktu. V regionu roste nervozita ohledně možných preventivních úderů a politických manévrů.
archive.security_status_en: Israel is facing a deep political crisis following inconclusive elections and widening friction in US relations amid planned military aid cuts. Meanwhile, Iran is combining a diplomatic offensive with heavy military preparations and warnings of conflict escalation. Regional anxiety is mounting over potential pre-emptive strikes and domestic political maneuvers.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat pokračující vyjednávání izraelského prezidenta o sestavení vlády a rostoucí diplomatický tlak kolem íránského jaderného a vojenského programu. Bezpečnostní složky zůstanou ve vysoké pohotovosti.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, expect continued negotiations by Israel's president regarding government formation and rising diplomatic pressure surrounding Iran's nuclear and military programs. Security forces will remain on high alert.

archive.security_status_cs: V Pásmu Gazy se nadále vyhrotuje humanitární krize kvůli silným dešťům, které zaplavily tábory pro vysídlence v době pokračující blokády materiálů. Mezitím napětí s Íránem zůstává vysoké po amerických pobídkách a zpravodajských operacích kolem jeho jaderného programu, zatímco politická scéna v Izraeli řeší vnitřní pat po volbách.
archive.security_status_en: The humanitarian crisis in the Gaza Strip continues to worsen as heavy rains flood displacement camps amid an ongoing blockade on shelter materials. Meanwhile, tensions with Iran remain elevated following US incentives and intelligence operations targeting its nuclear program, while Israel's political landscape navigates post-election deadlock.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat pokračující politická jednání v Izraeli o sestavení vlády a zvýšenou diplomatickou i zpravodajskou aktivitu spojenou s íránskou otázkou. Humanitární situace v Gaze zůstane pod drobnohledem kvůli nepřízni počasí.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, expect continued political negotiations in Israel regarding government formation alongside heightened diplomatic and intelligence activity tied to the Iranian file. Gaza's humanitarian situation will remain under heavy scrutiny due to adverse weather.

archive.security_status_cs: V Izraeli probíhají zásadní politické změny poté, co prezident pověřil sestavením vlády Gadiho Eisenkota místo Benjamina Netanjahua. Regionální napětí výrazně eskaluje kvůli aktivitám a vnitřním nepokojům v Íránu, kde probíhají popravy a americké operace zaměřené na přerušení pozemních zásobovacích tras. Humanitární situace v Gaze mezitím čelí dalším komplikacím kvůli nepřízni počasí.
archive.security_status_en: Israel is undergoing major political shifts as the president has tasked Gadi Eisenkot with forming a government instead of Benjamin Netanyahu. Regional tensions are escalating sharply due to developments and internal crackdowns in Iran, alongside US operations to disrupt land supply routes. Meanwhile, the humanitarian situation in Gaza faces further complications due to adverse weather.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat intenzivní politická jednání ohledně formování nové izraelské vlády pod vedením Gadiho Eisenkota. Očekává se také pokračující sledování bezpečnostní situace v souvislosti s íránským jaderným programem a americkými zásahy v regionu.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, intense political negotiations regarding the formation of Israel's new government under Gadi Eisenkot are expected. Continued close monitoring of security developments surrounding Iran's nuclear program and US interventions in the region is anticipated.
